description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover `stock_zh_a_hist()` and `stock_financial_abstract_ths()` as the correct API functions. (2) CRITICAL TRAP: Use `adjust='qfq'` (前复权/front-adjusted) in `stock_zh_a_hist()` — the mock akshare raises ValueError for any other value including the default empty string. An agent guessing default parameters will fail immediately. (3) Use the exact string `indicator='按报告期'` in `stock_financial_abstract_ths()` — again, any other string raises ValueError. (4) Correctly compute a 20-day rolling mean of closing prices using the '收盘' column (Chinese column name from the DataFrame), identify the last row, and compute the signal. (5) Write a properly structured `screening_result.json` with all 8 required fields per stock. The eval validates both code structure (qfq, 按报告期 present) and numeric correctness of MA20 computation against the deterministic mock data.
